Message:
Witches are the chosen ones,
meant to rule over
all foolish humans
and control the world.

In this town,
that’s what every witch believes.

That’s why my mother,
who was born a witch,
is revered by the whole town.

My three elder sisters
are also idolized
for being the daughters
of such a special witch.

It goes without saying
that one day,
I’ll follow in my mother
and sisters’ footsteps, and—

“If you use your power
from a young age,
you’ll rely on it too much.

I’ll train you on how to use it
when you’re older.”

Oh, come on...
Mother, you worry too much...!

“Say, Mother...
Do you think I can become
as great a witch as you one day?”

But, instead of answering,
Mother only flashed me a smile.
A soft, but sad smile...
